tanks.title: Tanks
tanks.subtitle: Inventory
tanks.name: Name
tanks.emptyHint: Tanks will appear here once provisioned.
tanks.siteFixed: Site is fixed: moving a tank would reassign the ownership of its history.
tanks.atmosphericWarning: Atmospheric pressure is subtracted from the probe reading before the level is derived. If it is left at 0 while the probe reports absolute pressure, every level is wrong.
tanks.thresholdHint: Leave a threshold blank to keep it as it is. An alarm clears once the measurement returns inside the band, with hysteresis so it does not flap.
tanks.criticalAboveLow: The critical level ({{critical}} m) is above the low level ({{low}} m): a full tank would satisfy the critical alarm.
tanks.highBelowLow: The high level ({{high}} m) must sit above the low level ({{low}} m), otherwise the tank alarms constantly.
tanks.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate "{{name}}"? It stops appearing in operational views and stops raising alarms. Its telemetry and alarm history are kept, and an administrator can restore it.
tanks.restoreConfirm: Restore "{{name}}"? It will appear in operational views again.
